paragraphs:
I’m a Product Designer based in Berlin, with a background spanning architecture, UX research, and end-to-end product design.

I originally trained in architecture, where I learned to think about systems, constraints, and how people interact with the things we create. That way of thinking eventually led me into UX research and product design, and it still influences how I approach problems today.

My research background also taught me not to jump into solutions too quickly. I like to understand what is actually happening first, combining user research, behavioral data, and business context to make better product decisions.

Today, I work across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and product definition to interaction design, prototyping, validation, design systems, and delivery. I’m particularly comfortable with complex products and ambiguous problems, working closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to move from uncertainty to something tangible.

What I enjoy most is finding clarity in complexity, connecting user and business needs, and turning that understanding into products that feel simple.
